add.summary: Provision a service (kit add --list to see all adapters)

adr.summary: Enforce architecture decisions (ADR → gate): 'kit adr check' gates the repo on accepted ADRs' deterministic kit-enforce rules, cited to the ADR; 'kit adr list' shows enforced/documented. Zero-LLM (prose is never interpreted).

agent-audit.summary: Audit agent / MCP / hook configs for plaintext secrets + malware-shaped hooks

agent-config.summary: Inject a managed 'use kit' block into CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md / .cursorrules / .clinerules / .github/copilot-instructions.md

verify.summary: Prove zero-egress: assert every scanner that would run air-gapped resolves to a local artifact (no cloud-only, no registry semgrep config)

analyze.summary: Analyze repo + emit draft CLAUDE.md / RULES.md

anchor.summary: Seal the audit log with the machine-local HMAC key (--external also gets a receipt from KIT_EXTERNAL_ANCHOR_CMD — closes the same-UID gap)

export.summary: Emit the audit log for a SIEM (--format cef|syslog|json)

secrets.summary: Forensics: who/what touched each key + when (reads audit log)

verify.summary: Verify the audit log's keyless hash chain + HMAC anchor (--require-external demands a TSA receipt; exit 1 on break/forge/truncation)

audit.summary: View audit log of kit operations

elevate.summary: Mint elevation marker for destructive secret ops (TOTP/yes-prompt)

auth.summary: TOTP-gated elevation for destructive secret ops (elevate|status|revoke|setup-totp)

baseline.summary: Freeze current warnings into .kit-baseline.json so future runs gate only net-new findings

bootstrap.summary: Cold-start an ephemeral environment in one command: setup → identity → policy pull → profile import → memory restore, from one platform-injected seed (fail-closed floor, fail-open fuel, --json receipt) (experimental)

enforce.summary: Guided observe→enforce flip: readiness pre-flight (refuses unless ready; --force overrides), set [scope].enforce_runtime = true, re-sign the profile scope, and audit the transition

enforce-readiness.summary: Read the recorded observe window (.kit-audit.jsonl) and report whether it's safe to flip exec-broker to enforce: ready | would-block (+ exactly what breaks) | untested (--gate fails CI on any not-ready verdict)

broker.summary: exec-broker runtime posture — graduate observe→enforce on evidence: enforce-readiness reports ready | would-block (+ what breaks) | untested; enforce does the guided, signed flip (refuses unless ready, --force overrides) (--json, --gate, --force)

compare.summary: Diff two `kit check --json` runs — what changed, with lost coverage ranked above a regression

check.summary: Check status of all tools, services, secrets, and lock files

ci.summary: CI-native check: GitHub Actions annotations, GitLab JUnit, JSON (--init gitlab|bitbucket scaffolds a pipeline)

clone.summary: Clone a Git repository and run kit setup

knobs.summary: List power-user env vars + .kit.toml fields kit honors (--json)

migrate.summary: Migrate .kit.toml to the current schema version (--dry-run inspect, --check CI gate, --force overwrite backup)

--prompt.summary: Print a compact active-gcloud indicator for your shell prompt (PS1)

check.summary: Verify each CLI's live account+project matches .kit.toml [context] (exits non-zero on mismatch)

use.summary: Activate the declared context: gcloud config + repo git identity

context.summary: Show project context: tools, services, secrets, environment

coverage.summary: Evidence map: which standard's controls kit's deterministic checks auto-verify vs gap/manual/n-a — --standard=asvs|llm-top10|ssdf|agentic-top10|mcp-top10|aiuc-1|gcp-waf-security|all (default asvs); --list-standards to enumerate, [coverage].standards to toggle on/off (NOT a compliance attestation; --json for GRC tools)

create-plugin.summary: Scaffold a new kit plugin package

design.summary: Check design quality (a11y, design tokens) against the baseline

doctor.summary: Deep diagnostics — checks environment health in detail

switch.summary: Switch active environment (dev/staging/prod). Gates prod-key reads.

gate-bash.summary: PreToolUse install-gate: read an agent's pending Bash command on stdin, block (exit 2) un-triaged installs

gate-egress.summary: PreToolUse egress-gate (exec-broker): block (exit 2) Bash network targets outside the signed [scope].egress — fail-closed without a verified scope

gate-env.summary: PreToolUse env-gate: read an agent's pending Write/Edit on stdin, block (exit 2) plaintext secrets aimed at .env* files

gate-fs.summary: PreToolUse fs-gate (exec-broker): block (exit 2) Write/Edit outside the signed [scope].fs — fail-closed without a verified scope

gha-audit.summary: CI hardening lint — unpinned actions/images + pwn-request/remote-include (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Bitbucket Pipelines)

governance.summary: View governance status and agent access controls

guard.summary: Install gate for YOUR terminal (observe mode): PATH shims for npm/npx/brew/pip/bun/… log what the gate would decide — install | status | uninstall

guard-observe.summary: Shim protocol (invoked by ~/.kit/shims wrappers, not by you): record what the install gate would decide for a package-manager call

heal.summary: Loop: auto-fix safe findings, re-scan until green; gate destructive, fail-closed on tamper (--dry-run, --agent)

health.summary: Deep environment health diagnostics — granular pass/fail across tools, services, config

identity.summary: Manage this machine/agent's Ed25519 identity (init/show/rotate) — asymmetric, attributable signing for audit/policy (experimental)

ingest.summary: Ingest external SARIF / OSV reports into kit's consolidated verdict (kit ingest <sarif|osv> <file>)

init.summary: Detect stack, generate .kit.toml, and run full setup (--no-setup: config + lock files only; merges ~/.kit/defaults.toml [init] services)

insight.summary: Deterministic lifecycle insight (unused: loaded-but-never-called MCP servers, from the transcript index; --json)

--plan.summary: Show the resolved auth strategy per service (vault/interactive/capture + passkey) without logging in

login.summary: Guided login to all configured services

map.summary: Deterministic repo-map: the relevant slice of files around a seed (import graph, --depth, --budget, --co-change, --json) — load part of a growing repo, not all of it (experimental)

mcp.summary: MCP server over stdio (Claude Code/Cursor/Codex); 'kit mcp list|auth|set-token|clear' manages declared servers

area.summary: Show shared entries for one area (decisions, how-built, status, security)

backup.summary: Encrypted backup of the memory store (AES-256-GCM; KIT_MEMORY_PASSPHRASE)

context.summary: Push-surface active decisions for the area(s) whose files you're touching (deterministic, path→cluster)

index.summary: Index ~/.claude transcripts into the SQLite memory store

install.summary: Wire UserPromptSubmit + SessionEnd + SessionStart (recovery) hooks into ~/.claude/settings.json

merge.summary: Merge another machine's memory.db into this one (dedup by uuid)

restore.summary: Restore an encrypted memory backup (e.g. on a new machine)

resume.summary: Print the resume command for a saved copilot (by name or number)

save.summary: Bookmark the current session as a named copilot

scan.summary: Scan the memory store for stored secrets, or prompt-injection patterns with --injection (exit 1 on a high-confidence finding)

search.summary: Full-text search memory (current project; --global for all; --fresh = recency-aware ranking)

share.summary: Promote a curated, secret-scanned entry to the shared (team) memory

stats.summary: Show what the local memory store contains

suggest.summary: Emit a BYO-LLM review prompt (recent activity + open items) — pipe to your own model

sync.summary: Sync from a memory export or encrypted backup (mergeDb; last-write-wins, file_index excluded)

threads.summary: List saved copilots (current project; --global for all)

memory.summary: Local conversation memory — index transcripts + show stats

open.summary: Open service dashboard in browser (stripe, vercel, railway, etc.)

panic.summary: Compromise response: rotate identity + emit a signed revocation + audit it + print the platform-revocation checklist (experimental)

pkg.summary: Install package with mandatory triage (kit pkg npm:express)

plugin.summary: Discover and manage kit plugins (search, list, scaffold, install)

policy.summary: Signable org policy-as-code in .kit-policy.toml (init/show/validate/sign/verify/check/trust/pull/pull-revocations/approve) — identity-signed standard, org-distributable + enforced offline (experimental)

check.summary: Report declared-vs-discovered drift (--gate fails CI on any drift; honest skip when no profile declared)

export.summary: Export a portable signed bundle (profile + signature + signer key) to --out or stdout

freeze.summary: Snapshot the discovered toolchain into .kit-profile.toml (preserves operator-authored workflows/plugins/scope/gates)

import.summary: Import a portable bundle on a fresh host — integrity-verify offline, fail-closed on tamper/revoked (authoritative only once the signer is anchored)

show.summary: Render the declared project profile with per-line reconciliation marks

sign.summary: Sign the profile (scope/RoE) into .kit-profile.sig via your identity/keystore — offline-verifiable

verify.summary: Verify .kit-profile.sig offline (--key pin → local identity → org .kit-policy.signers)

profile.summary: Versioned, traveling project profile — declare {skills, mcp, workflows, plugins, vault, gates, scope}, audit declared-vs-discovered drift, sign the scope/RoE, and export/import a portable signed bundle to a fresh host (show|freeze|check|sign|verify|export|import; --json, --gate, --key, --out)

review.summary: Full repo audit — runs check + design + standards + adr in one gate (for agents / PR checks; --json emits one structured report; --stages check,standards scopes the run, --category scopes the standards stage)

run.summary: Execute a command with project env vars loaded

sbom.summary: Generate a CycloneDX / SPDX SBOM from the lockfile (SARIF emit via kit scan --sarif)

scan.summary: Run external scanners (snyk/trivy/grype/semgrep/osv) and merge them into one local verdict; --list-delegates shows the toggleable scanner library, [scan].delegates picks which run (--strict / [governance.scan] required_scanners gate non-running scanners)

migrate.summary: Migrate plaintext secrets in .env* → configured vault

onecli.summary: Register a key with OneCLI gateway so agent never sees the real value

propagate.summary: Push a value to deploy targets only (skips vault-write). --stdin safer than --value

purge-history.summary: Destructive: rewrite git history to remove a leaked value (--force-history)

revoke-old.summary: Revoke a previously-minted scoped key (Supabase Mgmt API)

rotate.summary: Rotate a key: write new value to vault (explicit / random)

set.summary: Capture a value to the vault: kit secrets set <KEY> --stdin (safer) | --value <v>

sync.summary: Push resolved secrets to GitHub Actions / .env.ci / stdout

check-gitignore.summary: Verify .gitignore covers sensitive paths (--fix to auto-patch)

clear-cache.summary: Clear cached scanner binary (after intentional rebuild)

costs.summary: Snapshot per-key spend vs policy cap (Stripe live; others stubbed)

prescan.summary: Multi-repo baseline sweep (secrets, gitignore, branch-protect; --deep adds CVE/workflow-drift/bumblebee; --format=json + --vs-baseline=<path> for CI drift)

prescan-diff.summary: Diff two prescan reports — surface new regressions + fixed findings since baseline

scan-build.summary: Scan build artifacts (.next/, dist/) for inlined secrets

scan-staged.summary: Pre-commit: scan staged files for credential patterns

scan-transcripts.summary: Scan agent transcripts + prompt caches for leaked credentials

verify-pull.summary: After git pull: audit new deps, gitignore drops, introduced secrets

security.summary: Security policy + scanners (policy | scan-staged | scan-build | verify-pull | prescan | …)

self-audit.summary: Audit kit's own source against its 12 self-hardening rules (--list-rules, --only=<ids>, --format)

sentinel.summary: Autonomous redline watcher — propose/apply guarded remediations (run|install|status)

--recommended.summary: Opinionated profile: setup + memory hooks + git secret-scan/context-check gates

setup.summary: Full pipeline: install → login → secrets → agent config → verify

skill.summary: Module-discipline linter for a SKILL.md: contract shape, trigger + sibling-collision, declared least-privilege scope, and CI regression drift — plus --runtime to audit recorded runs for scope-adherence + negative controls (from the transcript index, zero-LLM) (test <path> [--runtime] [--json] [--gate] [--update-snapshot]) — proves a skill is engineered like a module, NOT that its output is good (rubric grading is delegated) (experimental)

slopsquat.summary: Score npm/PyPI packages for hallucination/slopsquat risk (registry metadata)

standards.summary: Dev-standards gate: general metrics + per-language linters + user plugins vs the baseline (--category general|specific|plugins|<lang>, --enforce fails CI)

status.summary: Adoption checklist — what's set up across kit + the next step for each gap

statusline.summary: Compact one-line status (mode score · update · open PAL) for any agent's info bar — wire into Claude Code statusLine / a shell PS1

supply-chain.summary: Install-time supply-chain triage: install-scripts, lockfile-drift, dep-confusion, slopsquat

team.summary: Manage team members, roles, and permissions (RBAC, invitations, audit logs)

triage.summary: Security evaluation before installing packages, images, or skills

verify-provenance.summary: Verify a release's SLSA provenance bundle offline (Ed25519 + SHA256 / cosign)

info.summary: Deterministic, local-first developer-environment manager and fail-closed governance layer for AI agents and humans.
info.title: kit
